title: 超越WER：口音对话ASR中的实体与不流畅词召回
summary: 针对口音对话英语ASR中命名实体和填充停顿召回率低的问题，提出三阶段流水线：SQL启发式筛选实体丰富数据、区域LoRA适配器微调Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、六类错误分类法。实体召回率从53-55%提升至80-85%，填充词召回率从<5%提升至76-86%，WER为6-10%，以10倍更少参数匹配30B零样本模型。
summary_en: Addressing low named entity and filler recall in accented conversational English ASR, this work presents a three-stage pipeline: SQL heuristic curation of entity-rich data, regional LoRA adapters fine-tuned on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B, and a six-category error taxonomy. Entity recall rises from 53-55% to 80-85%, filler recall from <5% to 76-86%, with 6-10% WER, matching a zero-shot 30B model with 10x fewer parameters.
